description: A central store module managing courses, modules, assignments, and quizzes for an educational platform. Handles data persistence, synchronization with backend API, and provides functions for data retrieval and updates.

methods.name: loadInitial
methods.description: Initializes store state with default data including courses, assignments, and quiz configurations.

methods.name: inferPathSlugFromTags
methods.description: Maps course tags to URL path slugs based on predefined role tags.

methods.name: syncBackendCourses
methods.description: Fetches courses from backend API and transforms them into canonical format, merging with existing data.

methods.name: loadState
methods.description: Loads persisted state from localStorage or initializes default state.

methods.name: saveState
methods.description: Saves current store state to localStorage.

methods.name: getCanonicalState
methods.description: Returns current store state, performing background sync with backend if needed.

methods.name: syncCoursesFromBackend
methods.description: Manually triggers synchronization of courses with backend API.

methods.name: subscribeCanonical
methods.description: Registers a listener for state changes.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Updates store state and notifies listeners.
